entities.summary: Dungannon is a town in County Tyrone, Northern Ireland. It is the second-largest town in the historic county and had a population of 16,282 at the 2021 Census. Since 2015, the town shares local government with Magherafelt and Cookstown in the Mid-Ulster District Council.
